title: Cyber Insurance Proposal Form (Full)
desc: The complete pre-application questionnaire. Sections A-Q covering company profile, financial exposure, data handling, regulatory position, eleven security-control domains, loss history and the coverage sought, with an evidence annexure and declaration.

title: Rating Addendum (pricing V2)
audience: All applicants, with the full form
desc: The facts the premium model rates on that the 1.0 form does not ask: NIC 2008 code, RBI/SEBI regulation, material incidents with the definition, a yes / no / don't know answer for each priced control, payment verification, and the misrepresentation declaration.

title: Short-Form Screening Questionnaire
desc: A condensed subset covering the sections that most affect price and eligibility - the four Tier-1 controls, claims history, sector and coverage structure. Produces an indicative quotation only.

title: Supplementary: Security Controls
desc: The eleven security-control sections (E-N) as a standalone form, for applicants completing the security review separately from the commercial sections.

title: Supplementary: India Regulatory Declarations
desc: Section Q as a standalone form - DPDP Act 2023, CERT-In 2022, sector-regulator declarations, and the statutory proposal-form declarations under the Insurance Act, 1938.
